MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

3. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

   C. 40
   D. 400
